close_reason: Fixed: RFC 8621 §5.8 compliance — force-null id/blobId/threadId/mailboxIds/keywords/receivedAt in Email/parse responses after filter_properties.
description: RFC 8621 §5.8 requires id, blobId, threadId, mailboxIds, keywords, and receivedAt to be null in Email/parse responses. The handler correctly omits them from the default property list, but if a client explicitly requests them via properties:["mailboxIds"] they get non-null values ({} for maps, a real timestamp for receivedAt, a synthetic id for id). The Email struct has no Option<> on these fields, so the fix requires post-processing in handle_email_parse to force-null the 6 metadata fields after filter_properties. Oracle: RFC 8621 §5.8 prose + jmap-test-suite parse-null-metadata.
title: Email/parse: null metadata fields when explicitly requested
